results.title: Smith in the World
results.content: # Smith in the World. The annual Smith in the World Conference celebrates the incredible off-campus work students achieve through internships, community service, and research. The conference features presentations by student panelists who reflect on their experiences and the impact those experiences have had on their academic work and future plans. Whether working with Tibetan Buddhists in China, volunteering at a hospital in Zimbabwe, or providing community service in New Orleans, Smith in the World gives students an opportunity to share their stories. The nomination window for Smith in the World 2026 has closed. Watch Recording of Education, Nonprofit, Social Impact. Students will share their experiences in: mental health in rural Peru; teaching in Senegal; and empowering mothers with nutrition education for healthy pregnancies. Watch Recording of Health Professions. Students will share their experiences in: public health research and clinical shadowing in Kenya; dental assisting in California; physical therapy for the USA Volleyball team; veterinary assisting at a small animal practice; and psychiatry at Boston Medical Center.
